# Focused direction check

Use only when a real tension in the proposed direction remains unresolved. Present a concrete
scenario drawn from project evidence, the credible choices and their tradeoff, and the narrow
human decision that changes the work. Avoid generic hypotheticals and fixed question counts.

Feed the answer back into the calling task's decision record. Stop when the decision is clear;
do not generate a second round of hypothetical concerns after convergence.
